functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trainer_login_status()
 RETURNS TABLE(trainer_id uuid, last_sign_in_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nicht berechtigt'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT t.id, u.last_sign_in_at FROM public.trainers t JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = t.user_id;
END $function$

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.next_number(_scope text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _year integer := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now())::int;
  _next integer;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.number_sequences (scope, year, last_value)
  VALUES (_scope, _year, 1)
  ON CONFLICT (scope, year) DO UPDATE SET last_value = number_sequences.last_value + 1
  RETURNING last_value INTO _next;
  RETURN _year::text || '-' || LPAD(_next::text, 4, '0');
END;
$function$

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_direct_trainer_booking()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.course_id IS NOT NULL
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.courses WHERE id = NEW.course_id AND direct_trainer_booking)
     AND NOT (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'admin') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'staff'))) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Dieser Kurs ist nur direkt bei der Trainerin/dem Trainer buchbar.' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: bump_voucher_usage

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bump_voucher_usage()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.vouchers SET times_used = times_used + 1 WHERE id = NEW.voucher_id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: has_active_video_access
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_active_video_access(_user_id uuid, _course_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.video_course_access
    WHERE user_id = _user_id AND course_id = _course_id
      AND (
        status = 'active'
        OR (status = 'grace' AND grace_until IS NOT NULL AND grace_until > now())
        OR (status = 'cancelled' AND current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND current_period_end > now())
      )
  )
$function$

functions.name: consume_class_card_credit
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_class_card_credit(_card_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_remaining integer;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.class_cards
  SET remaining_credits = remaining_credits - 1
  WHERE id = _card_id
    AND remaining_credits > 0
    AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())
  RETURNING remaining_credits INTO new_remaining;
  RETURN new_remaining;
END;
$function$

functions.name: refund_class_card_credit
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refund_class_card_credit(_card_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  new_remaining integer;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.class_cards
  SET remaining_credits = LEAST(total_credits, remaining_credits + 1)
  WHERE id = _card_id
  RETURNING remaining_credits INTO new_remaining;
  RETURN new_remaining;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_has_course_booking(_user_id uuid, _course_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.bookings b
    WHERE b.user_id = _user_id
      AND b.course_id = _course_id
  )
$function$

functions.name: get_course_participant_counts
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_course_participant_counts(_course_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(course_id uuid, participants_count integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT c.id AS course_id,
         COALESCE(COUNT(b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'confirmed'), 0)::int AS participants_count
  FROM unnest(_course_ids) AS c(id)
  LEFT JOIN public.bookings b ON b.course_id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.id
$function$
